name: Datte Suki Nandamon! ~Be With!~
original_name: だって好きなんだもん! ～Be With!～
source:
School setting. Main character fights and dates various girls, laughs and cries with them. Together they make their own adventure.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事以校园为舞台。主人公与形形色色的女孩战斗、约会，同她们一起欢笑、流泪，共同谱写属于自己的冒险。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
